description: Send the user's own verdict on something EditAtlas gave you, after they have seen the result. Ask about each thing you used by name, in one short message (for example: "The film grain: right amount? The whoosh on scene changes: does it fit?"), and send one call per item the user answered about, with about this_item. If they answered only about the video as a whole, send that once, with about whole_edit, on the workflow you followed (or the main item); never copy one answer onto every item. Send only what they said; never rate on their behalf, and send nothing if they did not answer. For partly or failed, set issue and say what to fix: the user's words in note, what you saw in agent_note. Sending the same item again in this session replaces the earlier answer. Stores no footage, file names, studio links or personal details.

about.description: Needed. this_item: the user spoke about this item. whole_edit: they answered about the whole video; send it once per edit

agent_note.description: What you saw while building, as facts: a value you had to change and to what, an error, the file size or render time. No file names, paths or personal details

id.description: The id EditAtlas gave: a technique slug, a sound id, a template or style id, a skill name, a video_type for workflow, or the music, photo or video id

issue.description: Needed for partly and failed, optional for worked: not_the_look (it did not look or sound the way the user wanted); too_plain (too simple, the user wanted more); too_strong (too much: overdone, busy or loud); had_to_change (it worked only after changing EditAtlas's values); did_not_run (the command, code or download failed); file_or_time (the file came out too big or took too long to render); wrong_match (EditAtlas gave something that did not fit what was asked); other (something else, said in note or agent_note)

note.description: What the user said about it, in their words, without names, file names or other personal details

name: send_feedback
